name: Zovo Expense Tracker
tagline: Log and categorize expenses and spending summaries
description: Record expenses by category, query spending and produce budget summaries. Hosted remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) with a focused tool set; runs at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/expense-tracker. A free access token can be minted at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and passed as an Authorization: Bearer header for tool calls; listing tools works anonymously. Source: https://github.com/theluckystrike/mcp-servers. Also available on npm as @theluckystrike/mcp-expense-tracker.
